home.title: VangAI | Never miss a customer again
home.description: One assistant that answers your phone, WhatsApp and website chat, in Dutch, French and English. Set up and run for you, from €50 a month.

demos.fallback: In this demo I only answer the three suggested questions. The live assistant is trained on your business and answers whatever your customers ask.

service.question: What does a basic service cost?
service.answer: A basic service is €89, oil and filter included. If we find anything else we call you first, so nothing lands on the invoice as a surprise.

visit.question: How fast can someone come by?
visit.answer: We normally have a slot within two working days. If you have broken down, tell me where you are and I will try to get you in today.

book.question: Can I book for this week?
book.answer: Yes. Thursday at 15:00 or Friday at 11:00 are free. Which one shall I put your name on?

whatsapp.notice: Messages are answered by an AI assistant
whatsapp.openingAnswer: Yes, we are open tomorrow 8:00 to 18:00. Anything I can help you with?
whatsapp.done: That is the demo. The real assistant answers your customers like this on WhatsApp, day and night.
